name: neo-nexus
description: Connect Codex engineering work with Neo-Nexus projects and client requests.

interface.shortDescription: Work on Neo-Nexus client requests from Codex.
interface.longDescription: Gives engineers permission-checked identity, project context, client tasks and issues, and Neo-Nexus tracking health inside Codex. Task status changes are attributed to the authenticated engineer and approved device. It never sends prompts or source files.
defaultPrompt: Who am I connected as in Neo-Nexus?
Show the Neo-Nexus context for this project.
What client requests should I work on?
Check Neo-Nexus tracking health for this repo.
